newsitem.title: ITALY: Whirlwind hits Venice beach town, 50 injured--RAI.
newsitem.headline: Whirlwind hits Venice beach town, 50 injured--RAI.

text.p: A whirlwind swept through the small beach town of Bibione, north of Venice on Sunday, injuring some 50 people and causing severe damage, Italian state news RAI said.

Most of the injured, who were brought to a nearby hospital, had been sleeping in camping grounds or in boats that were hit by the strong wind, RAI said. The gusts also blew down pine trees onto cars and buildings.
Italian news agency ANSA said the winds lifted up about a dozen boats that were anchored in the port, and damaged the roofs of several buildings in the Bibione area.
The strong winds also damaged around 20 cars parked in streets adjoining the beach, ANSA added.
RAI television news showed police and firefighters seaching the area for damage and injured people.
Bibione is a beach resort about 40 km (25 miles) northeast of Venice.
